story: Meet the Sabah Partridge (Tropicoperdix graydoni), a distinctive bird from the Phasianidae family. Preferring habitats such as Tropical lowland rainforest; primary lowland forests; and plantations below 500 m, this species has adapted to thrive under specific environmental conditions. With an IUCN status of Near Threatened (NT), its population trends are closely watched by scientists and enthusiasts. The Sabah Partridge serves as an indicator species for the health of its environment. Whether you are a seasoned ornithologist or a curious nature lover, learning about the Sabah Partridge enriches our understanding of nature.
